p: Puttshack was founded by the brothers behind Topgolf, and the first venue opened in 2018 at Westfield London in White City. The secret sauce is what the company calls Trackaball technology, which tracks every putt so the scoring is fully automatic and each hole can react to how you play. It means there are no disputes over who took six shots and who claims they only took four, which in some friendship groups is worth the ticket alone.

A few tips to get the most out of your round. Take a moment to watch how the first hole works before you start, so you know how to read the screens. Don't rush your putts; the courses are designed to be fun rather than fiendishly difficult, but a little care goes a long way. Mix up the order of who goes first each hole to keep things fair.

For a group, book ahead and arrive a little early to grab a drink and get your bearings. Think about whether you want to eat before, during or after your round, as the bar and kitchen make it easy to make an evening of it.

The City is very well connected by public transport, with Bank and Monument stations close by, and Liverpool Street and Cannon Street not far off, so getting there and back is simple. On weekday evenings, the area fills up with after-work crowds, so booking ahead is especially wise.
